description: This file implements a Redis cache class with both synchronous and asynchronous methods for caching, retrieving, and managing Redis data, including support for Redis clusters, scripting, pipeline operations, and health checks.

classes.name: RedisCache
classes.description: A class providing Redis caching functionalities with support for both sync and async operations, including key management, pipeline execution, scripting, and health checks.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes RedisCache with connection parameters, sets up health pings, and manages cache size and version info.

methods.name: _setup_health_pings
methods.description: Sets up asynchronous and synchronous health check pings to Redis.

methods.name: _handle_async_ping_error
methods.description: Handles errors during async Redis ping, logs failure.

methods.name: _handle_sync_ping_error
methods.description: Handles errors during sync Redis ping, logs failure.

methods.name: _get_async_client_cache_key
methods.description: Generates a cache key for the async Redis client based on connection parameters.

methods.name: init_async_client
methods.description: Initializes or retrieves a cached async Redis client connection.

methods.name: check_and_fix_namespace
methods.description: Ensures cache keys start with the specified namespace.

methods.name: _parse_redis_major_version
methods.description: Parses Redis version string to extract the major version number.

methods.name: set_cache
methods.description: Sets a cache value in Redis with optional TTL.

methods.name: increment_cache
methods.description: Increments a numeric cache value with optional TTL management.

methods.name: async_scan_iter
methods.description: Asynchronously scans Redis keys matching a pattern.

methods.name: async_register_script
methods.description: Registers a Lua script with Redis for later execution.

methods.name: async_set_cache
methods.description: Asynchronously sets a cache value in Redis.

methods.name: _pipeline_helper
methods.description: Helper for executing a batch of set operations in a Redis pipeline.

methods.name: async_set_cache_pipeline
methods.description: Uses Redis pipeline to set multiple cache entries asynchronously.

methods.name: _set_cache_sadd_helper
methods.description: Helper for adding multiple members to a Redis set with optional TTL.

methods.name: async_set_cache_sadd
methods.description: Adds multiple members to a Redis set asynchronously.

methods.name: batch_cache_write
methods.description: Buffers cache writes and flushes when buffer size exceeds threshold.

methods.name: async_increment
methods.description: Asynchronously increments a numeric cache value with optional TTL.

methods.name: flush_cache_buffer
methods.description: Flushes buffered cache writes to Redis.

methods.name: _get_cache_logic
methods.description: Processes cached responses, decoding bytes and parsing JSON.

methods.name: get_cache
methods.description: Retrieves a cache value from Redis.

methods.name: _run_redis_mget_operation
methods.description: Wrapper for Redis mget operation (sync).

methods.name: _async_run_redis_mget_operation
methods.description: Wrapper for Redis mget operation (async).

methods.name: batch_get_cache
methods.description: Bulk retrieval of multiple cache entries from Redis.

methods.name: async_get_cache
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a cache value from Redis.

methods.name: async_batch_get_cache
methods.description: Bulk asynchronous retrieval of cache entries.

methods.name: sync_ping
methods.description: Synchronous Redis ping test.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Asynchronous Redis ping test.

methods.name: delete_cache_keys
methods.description: Deletes multiple cache keys asynchronously.

methods.name: client_list
methods.description: Returns list of connected Redis clients.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns Redis server info.

methods.name: flush_cache
methods.description: Flushes all Redis cache.

methods.name: flushall
methods.description: Alias for flush_cache.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from Redis connection pool.

methods.name: test_connection
methods.description: Tests Redis connection by creating a new client and pinging.

methods.name: async_delete_cache
methods.description: Deletes a cache key asynchronously.

methods.name: delete_cache
methods.description: Deletes a cache key synchronously.

methods.name: _pipeline_increment_helper
methods.description: Helper for executing batch increment operations in a pipeline.

methods.name: async_increment_pipeline
methods.description: Executes batch increment operations in Redis pipeline asynchronously.

methods.name: async_get_ttl
methods.description: Retrieves TTL of a key asynchronously.

methods.name: async_rpush
methods.description: Appends values to a Redis list asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_lpop_count_for_older_redis_versions
methods.description: Handles multiple LPOP commands for Redis versions below 7.0.

methods.name: async_lpop
methods.description: Performs LPOP operation on Redis list asynchronously, with support for count.
